about: S62's last drawing (the spinning sword at rest, point up, at the apex) for the S63 match cut to the starship. Written by the marble/gold agent from video/src/scenes/chorus2.js (S62: swordAngle, s62cam, swordGeom, swordStrokes).

frame.units: x as a fraction of frame width, y and lengths as fractions of frame height (y down)

angle_note: direction hilt -> tip in screen coordinates (0 = pointing right, -90 = pointing straight up); the sword has just stopped spinning (clockwise, 2 turns since the release at 212.07)
look: a dark bronze leaf-bladed xiphos silhouette (umber-bronze body, a burning gold sunward edge on its left) against bright golden-hour cloud; the sky around it brightens to a warm opening (#ffdb99-ish) behind it
motion_into_cut: angular velocity decays as (1 - s)^2 to exactly 0 at 215.29; the camera has settled (zoom 1.55, centred on the sword); no translation in the last ~0.4 s
portrait_note: 4:5 / 9:16 use the same frame-centre composition (the camera centres the sword at x = .5, y = .47 of the frame in every aspect)
